name: Kampot pepper
where: La Plantation official shop or Kurata Pepper shop
about: A Cambodian pepper with Geographical Indication status, grown in the Kampot region. It is a prized local product that carries the name of its place of origin.
tip: Check that the pack is sealed and shows proof of origin certification.

name: Khmer krama scarf
about: A checked cotton cloth used across Cambodia for everyday needs, from wrapping to sun protection. It is a symbol of Khmer daily life.
tip: Ask whether the cloth is handwoven locally, and learn the difference between cotton and silk.
